Booth Operator

Roll d6

This booth operator... | Roll | Description | |---|---| | 1 | rigs the game against the players. | | 2 | gives out extra tickets if they like you. | | 3 | is not running the booth they wanted to run. | | 4 | has a crush on another booth operator. | | 5 | is an unprepared last-minute replacement. | | 6 | speaks with their mouth stuffed with dragon tails. |
